description: Stripe's OpenAPI spec declares no Idempotency-Key header, but the API accepts one on every v1 POST and on every v2 POST and DELETE (https://docs.stripe.com/api/idempotent_requests: 'For API v1, all POST requests accept idempotency keys. Don't send idempotency keys in GET and DELETE requests because it has no effect.'; https://docs.stripe.com/api-v2-overview: 'API v1 only supports idempotent replay for POST requests. API v2 supports all POST and DELETE requests.'). Stripe's official Node client sends the header on exactly those methods (stripe-node src/RequestSender.ts, _defaultIdempotencyKey). This adds an optional `idempotencyKey` header member to the input of each of those operations, and gives CreateBillingMeterEventSession, which has no input, an input that holds only that member.
